title: Leray comparison when direct-image higher derived functors vanish
statement: Let f:Z\to X be a continuous map of topological spaces [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology], let f_* be the direct-image functor on abelian sheaves [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology] given by (f_*F)(U)=F(f^{-1}U), and let R^qf_* be its right derived functors [def-sp-left-exact-additive]. If R^qf_*F=0 for every q>0, then for every p>=0 the Leray edge map gives a natural isomorphism H^p(Z,F)\cong H^p(X,f_*F) [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology].

proof.text: The Leray spectral-sequence statement [lem-sc-topological-leray-spectral-sequence] supplies pages (E_r^{a,b},d_r)_{r>=2} with E_2^{a,b}=H^a(X,R^bf_*F), a finite decreasing filtration of H^{a+b}(Z,F), and identifies the edge map E_2^{p,0}=H^p(X,f_*F)\to E_\infty^{p,0}=F^pH^p(Z,F)\subseteq H^p(Z,F) as the map induced by f.

If R^bf_*F=0 for b>0, then E_2^{a,b}=0 for b!=0. For r>=2 every d_r has source or target off row zero: if its target has second index zero, then its source has b=r-1>=1, and otherwise the target is already off row zero. Thus all d_r vanish and E_\infty=E_2. For total degree n, the filtration has F^aH^n/F^{a+1}H^n\cong E_\infty^{a,n-a}=0 for a!=n, so F^nH^n=H^n; the edge map E_2^{n,0}\to H^n(Z,F) is therefore an isomorphism.
